items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: thanks to people like Clark Terry and Jonah Jones, Doc Sevrinson.

ctx.x: to see. Now as we settle down, all the young fellows have got to have a chance, we get back to playing a little jazz and teaching and doing some of the things we like to do.

I have 20 pupils so I have a good foundation with that. And they're getting better, thanks to people like Clark Terry and Jonah Jones, Doc Sevrinson. They send people to me all the time so I'm getting better pupils and whatnot. In fact, Jonah took some lessons from me, did you know that?
No, but I know you'd be good for him.
